BMI.evidence: Nine newly diagnosed diet-controlled T2DM patients (4:5, male/female) and eight age- and body mass index (BMI)-matched non-diabetic control (4:4, male/female) subjects were enrolled to this study.

disease_state.evidence: These data can be used for qualitative, quantitative, and kinetics study of human serum proteins under healthy and type 2 diabetes conditions.

material_type.evidence: Control subjects and type 2 diabetic patients were given deuterium-labeled (heavy) water for a seven-day period and their plasma serum proteins were analyzed by high-resolution mass spectrometry.
